## Problem and resulting behavior

Explain the concrete issue, scope and final behavior. Link relevant issues or research questions.

## Validation and evidence

List commands, source/environment identity, actual outcomes and explicit skips.
Distinguish current runs from historical evidence. For experiments include the
predeclared protocol, baselines, seeds, budget and limitations.

## Rights and risk

Identify new or adapted third-party code, data or models with origin, exact revision,
license and required notices. Explain changes to trust boundaries or runtime behavior.

- [ ] I have read CONTRIBUTING.md and the current LICENSE, including its contribution terms.
- [ ] I have the right to submit the material and have identified third-party inputs.
- [ ] No credentials, private target data, raw payloads or unreviewed model artifacts are included.
- [ ] Verification stayed within the stated authorization and did not weaken protective checks.
- [ ] Claims match the linked evidence; unexecuted checks and unresolved risks are explicit.

## Release impact

State whether this changes public behavior, dependency requirements or scientific
claims. License migration, merge and release publication require separate explicit
maintainer decisions after the documented gates are met.
